reason: On Linux x86_64 with Python 3.12.3, I built a minimal hatchling wheel, created fresh virtual environments, and used one temporary cache. `uv 0.12.0 pip install ./dist/localpkg-1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl --cache-dir <cache>` succeeded and created a `wheels-v6/.../1.0.0-py3-none-any.rev` entry. Installing the same wheel into a new environment with uv 0.11.1 and the same cache exited 1 with `Failed to deserialize cache entry` and `array had incorrect length, expected 4`. The reverse comparison—uv 0.11.1 writing the cache and uv 0.12.0 reading it—succeeded.
